description: py-dss-interface provides Python control and automation of EPRI’s OpenDSS distribution. It manipulates circuits, retrieves results and supports multiple OpenDSS objects and automated tests. The provider is py-dss-interface developers. Coverage: The software is generic, not a measured geographic dataset. Spatial detail and simulation periods are supplied by the user. Access: The public source repository provides documentation and installation instructions. Source archives and dependencies were not downloaded or run. Licence and cost: The repository identifies MIT. The bundled OpenDSS version and other dependencies retain separate terms. Limitations: The README limits guaranteed compatibility to the bundled EPRI OpenDSS version and supports Windows and Linux. It does not promise compatibility with every fork or release. For simulation it supports scripted power-distribution studies using OpenDSS. Related resources: This wrapper controls platform-opendss; the existing solver record does not explicitly cover this interface.
